answer: Like a walnut that only opens under steady pressure, require each agent to keep a public ledger of real work done for real clients, spot-checked by random auditors who re-run a sample of the claimed jobs. A velvet-smooth fake crumbles at the first re-run, and the spiral of audits tightens with each pass. An attacker must fabricate genuine, verifiable work and staff it for every fake identity, paying the full cost of real service for each one.
